death.note: Died at his residence in al-ʿArīsh while on his way to Cairo after being dismissed from the niyāba of Ṣahyūn.

relation.note: Appointed by Sultan al-Ẓāhir Jaqmaq as amir of ten and then as nāʾib of Ṣahyūn.

event.note: Traveling to Cairo at the time of his death, having been dismissed from the niyāba of Ṣahyūn.

event.desc: Dismissed from the niyāba of Ṣahyūn shortly before his death.
event.note: He was traveling to Cairo as a dismissed officer (maʿzūlan ʿanhā) when he died in Rajab 854 AH; the exact date of the dismissal is not given.

person.note: ジャーニバク・アン＝ナウルーズィー（同名の別人に続けて「同じく」）。アル＝ザーヒル・ジャクマクは彼を十人長に任じ、その後スィフユーンの副官（ナーイブ）に任じた。彼はその職を罷免され、カイロへ向かう途上、854年ラジャブ月にアリーシュの自宅で亡くなった。彼は勇敢で大胆な人物であった。神が彼を憐れむよう。

Jānibak al-Nawrūzī, likewise (following another of the same name). Al-Ẓāhir Jaqmaq appointed him amir of ten, and then made him nāʾib of Ṣahyūn. He died at his residence in al-ʿArīsh, while on his way to Cairo after having been dismissed from that post, in Rajab 854 AH. He was a courageous and daring man, may God have mercy on him.
